sections.title: Safety Culture Assessment Record
sections.html:
Policy Summary: This form supports MISH 52 by documenting the annual safety culture assessment and the continuous-improvement plan that moves the organization toward a generative safety culture.

Procedure Capture: Record survey timing, anonymous participation, Hudson maturity results, and the 12-month improvement roadmap approved during the annual program review.

Task Use: Complete after each survey cycle and retain the results with the Safety Command review package so leaders can track progress and close gaps.
